name: Post Matric Scholarship to OBC Students (इतर मागासवर्गीय मॅट्रिकोत्तर शिष्यवृत्ती योजना)
department: Other Backward Bahujan Welfare Department, Government of Maharashtra
summary: Provides tuition fee reimbursement and monthly maintenance allowance to eligible OBC students pursuing post-matric courses with parental annual income up to Rs. 2.5 Lakh (MahaDBT active threshold). (DRAFT CANDIDATE - NON-PRODUCTION)
benefits: 100% Tuition Fee & Examination Fee in Government / Aided institutions; 50% in private unaided institutions
Monthly maintenance allowance paid for 10 months according to course group (Group A to E) for day scholars and hostellers
Book allowances and thesis completion charges for post-graduate/research scholars where applicable
required_documents: Caste Certificate (OBC) issued by Sub-Divisional Officer / Deputy Collector
Valid Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) Certificate for current financial year
Income Certificate (<= Rs. 2,50,000) issued by Tahsildar
College admission fee receipt and Bonafide Certificate

sources.evidence_excerpt: शासन निर्णय क्र. ईबीसी-२०१२/प्र.क्र.२२९/मावक-२ दिनांक १४ ऑक्टोबर २०१३: इतर मागास प्रवर्गातील विद्यार्थ्यांसाठी मॅट्रिकोत्तर शिष्यवृत्ती योजना. शिक्षण शुल्क, परीक्षा शुल्क व निर्वाह भत्ता अनुज्ञेय. (महाडीबीटी २.० वरील निकष: वार्षिक उत्पन्न मर्यादा रु. २.५० लाख).

sources.source_name: MahaDBT 2.0 Post-Matric OBC Scheme Portal Guidelines
sources.evidence_excerpt: MahaDBT 2.0 Official Scheme Details - Post Matric Scholarship to OBC Students: Applicant must belong to OBC category with valid Non-Creamy Layer. Parental annual income should be less than or equal to Rs. 2.50 Lakh. Mandatory 75% attendance. Provides fees and maintenance.

evidence.source_title: Maharashtra GR No. EBC-2012/CR229/Mavak-2 & MahaDBT Rules
evidence.verbatim_excerpt: अर्जदार विद्यार्थी हा इतर मागास प्रवर्गातील व महाराष्ट्राचा रहिवासी असावा.
evidence.translated_excerpt: Applicant student must belong to Other Backward Classes and be a resident of Maharashtra.

evidence.verbatim_excerpt: इतर मागास प्रवर्गातील (OBC) सक्षम प्राधिकरणाचे वैध जात प्रमाणपत्र असणे आवश्यक आहे.
evidence.translated_excerpt: Valid caste certificate of OBC category issued by competent authority is required.

evidence.verbatim_excerpt: विद्यार्थी मान्यताप्राप्त संस्थेत दहावीनंतरच्या उच्च शिक्षणात नियमित शिकत असावा.
evidence.translated_excerpt: Student must be regularly studying in recognized post-matric course in an approved institution.

evidence.verbatim_excerpt: Parental annual income should be less than or equal to Rs. 2.50 Lakh.
evidence.notes: Active MahaDBT portal specifies Rs. 2.5 Lakh. Base 2013 GR specified Rs. 1 Lakh. State GR amending threshold to 2.5L is not indexed on gr.maharashtra.gov.in; flagged for review.
